Font size tokens determine how big or small the referenced text will appear on the screen. The USWDS typescale includes nine regularized theme tokens drawn from 21 system tokens.

Please see the [Typesetting](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting) section for more about font size normalization and how USWDS uses tokens for typesetting. The documentation below displays a value in pixels, rather than the actual final output, which will be normalized depending on the typeface and output in `rem` customized to your project settings.

## Theme tokens

The following chart shows the USWDS default settings for the nine theme size tokens. Customize the output to your project needs in [USWDS settings configuration](https://designsystem.digital.gov/documentation/settings) by setting the variables listed in the default settings chart. If your project requires more than nine sizes, use [system size tokens](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/#system-tokens) as needed.

| Token | Default | Example | Value | Settings variable |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `'3xs'` | `2` | Tallahassee | 13px | $theme-type-scale-3xs |
| `'2xs'` | `3` | Tallahassee | 14px | $theme-type-scale-2xs |
| `'xs'` | `4` | Tallahassee | 15px | $theme-type-scale-xs |
| `'sm'` | `5` | Tallahassee | 16px | $theme-type-scale-sm |
| `'md'` | `6` | Tallahassee | 17px | $theme-type-scale-md |
| `'lg'` | `9` | Tallahassee | 22px | $theme-type-scale-lg |
| `'xl'` | `12` | Tallahassee | 32px | $theme-type-scale-xl |
| `'2xl'` | `14` | Tallahassee | 40px | $theme-type-scale-2xl |
| `'3xl'` | `15` | Tallahassee | 48px | $theme-type-scale-3xl |

## Using size tokens

Your context and coding style determine how you access USWDS font size tokens in code. Because of [font size normalization](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/), font size functions, utilities, and mixins also require a [family](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-family/) token.

| Context | Usage | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| function | size( [family](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-family/), [size](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/)) | font-size: size(`'body'`, `'2xl'`) |
| mixinfont-size | u-font-size( [family](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-family/), [size](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/)) | @include u-font-size(`'body'`, `'2xl'`) |
| mixinfont-familyfont-size | u-font( [family](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-family/), [size](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/)) | @include u-font(`'body'`, `'2xl'`) |
| setting | [size](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/) | $theme-h1-font-size: `'2xl'` |
| utilityfont-familyfont-size | .font- [family](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-family/)- [size](https://designsystem.digital.gov/design-tokens/typesetting/font-size/) | .font-`body`-`2xl` |
